Definition: Zerach, the name of three Israelites, also of an Idumaean and an Ethiopian prince
BiblicalUsage: Zerah or Zarah = "rising"; 1) a son of Reuel and grandson of Esau, one of the dukes of the Edomites; 2) twin brother of Pharez, sons of Judah and Tamar; descendants are called Zarhites, Ezrahites, and Izrahites; 3) son of Simeon; also called 'Zohar'; 4) a Gershonite Levite, son of Iddo of Adaiah; 5) the Ethiopian or Cushite, invader of Judah in the reign of Asa who defeated the invaders; probably the same as the Egyptian king Usarken I, second king of the Egyptian 22nd dynasty or perhaps more probably Usarken II, his 2nd successor; 6) another Edomite leader; possibly same as 1
